title: Shoulder Shrugs - FB
texts: Shoulder shrugs whilst dead hanging on a finger board

This workout is designed to increase strength in the muscles which control and stabilise your scapular whilst also working your forearm muscles in a specific manner. This is a great workout to do as an additional part to your fingerboard session completing it at the end of your FB warm up before any harder dead hangs workouts. It's also a good session to do before a hard pull up workout. 

Complete 6 sets of 4 reps of shoulder shrugs. Rest 90 seconds between each set. 
You can increase the load using additional weights in a rucksack or attached to a climbing harness. Only aim to reach a sub maximal intensity which is challenging but not close to failure. 

Focus on squeezing your abs and glutes throughout to maintain good form.
